claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded: One of the key symbols of Russia's occupation of Ukraine has suffered major damage after a seven-stage attack by Kyiv.
- Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
- Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.
- 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.
- Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.
- Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.
- US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.
- American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.
- William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.
- Trump in Asia ahead of talks with Russian and Chinese presidents: The US president said he would be open to a one-on-one meeting with Russia's Vladimir Putin "if it's available".
- Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed: Bilkis Bano has spoken of her "pain, shock and disbelief" at the top court order and vowed to fight back.
- Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.
